title: THE POMEGRANATE HOUR, 3 AM · The last episode
venue: the motel · the lobby TV at 3 AM · recaps never run · Box 13
logline: The channel gone: the lobby TV at 3 AM showing the motel's own lobby from a camera the motel doesn't have — the desk, the bell, a clerk in a maroon polo from behind — and the host's voice, drawn as a balloon from nowhere, blank. Wood turns around. The lobby is empty. He draws the screen. The recaps end.
